verdict.rationale: Sprinto is a SaaS platform with its own AI features (AI Editor, Sprinto AI evidence analysis), so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions any policy or control that keeps customer data out of AI model training. Its AI-governance module (shadow AI discovery, AI risk scoring, vendor due diligence) helps customers govern other AI systems, not Sprinto's own use of their data.
